AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING OF NOVEMBER 4, 2024 OF
THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE OF
THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes preparation.
The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Committee meetings.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES
1.
Meeting of February 28, 2019
Minutes
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
NEW AND OLD BUSINESS
2.
Discussion of Future Agenda Items. Staff will provide an overview of the topics tentatively calendared for future City Council and for future Finance Advisory Committee meetings. Staff will address the schedule for implementation of GovInvest, the schedule for receiving the final report for the Equipment Inventory (Dude Solutions), calendar for updating Schedule of Fees and Charges, and tentative staff plans for City Council review and approval of the FY 19-20 budget appropriation.
3.
Review and Discuss the Restricted Revenue Funds that Support Capital Improvement Projects. Staff will provide an overview of each Restricted Revenue Fund funding source and amount that is available for capital improvement projects. The Committee will discuss the data presented, the projections for capital and equipment expenditures, and estimates to include in the Committee’s financial projections.
Staff Report
4.
Review and Discuss the Raw Data (Pre Final Report) Received from Dude Solutions and Prosum Pertaining to City Hall Fixtures and Equipment, Vehicle Replacement, and Technology Related Items for Projecting General Fund Transfers and Expenditures to Cover Future Costs. The Committee will review the preliminary data received by the City for inclusion in the financial forecast.
Staff Report
5.
Review, Discuss and Finalize of the Committee's Preliminary Financial Projections and Recommendations for Presentation to the City Council. The Committee Chair will lead and facilitate a review and update of the Committee's financial projections, inclusive of reviewing projections from ad hoc committees, and the formulation of recommendations for presentation to the City Council.
Staff Report
